SSO & Bypass Public Notification

If a resident or citizen sees a manhole that is overflowing onto the street or ground, you can contact Waste Management Services twenty-four hours a day at 555-0100.

Recent SSO and Bypass Events:

October 1, 2026 at 5:52 AM, WMSD began Sanitary Sewer bypass pumping at a Sanitary Sewer Overflow located at the Example Lift Station (200-blk Example Ave).  The estimated volume of sewer discharged is 181,600 gallons; the duration of the event was 10 hours and 5 minutes.  A sample was collected, warning sign #1 was placed and bleach was applied to the area for disinfection.  Bypass pumping was the result of a wet weather event.

October 1, 2026 at 7:00 AM AM, WMSD began Sanitary Sewer bypassing at Sample Blvd and Fixture Dr (permitted overflow). The estimated volume of sewer discharged and the duration of the event are unknown.  A sample was collected, warning sign #28 was placed and the area needed no disinfection.  Bypassing was the result of a wet weather event.

October 1, 2026 at 7:40 AM, WMSD began Sanitary Sewer bypass pumping located at 9876 Example St.  The estimated volume of sewer discharged is unknown; the duration of the event was 12.1 hours.  A sample was collected, warning sign #9 was placed and the area needed no disinfection.  Bypass pumping was the result of a wet weather event.

October 1, 2026 at 7:40 AM, WMSD began Sanitary Sewer bypass pumping at Sample Rd and Example Dr.  The estimated volume of sewer discharged is 167,000 gallons; the duration of the event was 7.75 hours.  Bypass pumping was the result of a wet weather event.

September 28, 2026 at 8:46 AM, WMSD was notified of a Sanitary Sewer Overflow located at 1234 W Example Hwy.  The estimated volume of sewer discharged is 5,000 gallons; the duration of the event was 2.5 hours.  The overflow was the result of debris and rags, resulting in a plugged sanitary sewer main.

July 31, 2026, at 7:04PM, WMSD was notified of a Sanitary Sewer Overflow located at the Example lift station. The estimated volume of sewer discharged is 6,000 gallons; the duration of the event is two hours, 30 minutes. A sample was collected.

October 23, 2025, at11:00AM, WMSD was notified of a Sanitary Sewer Overflow located at the 2500-blk of Example Blvd, behind the strip mall.  The volume of sewage discharged and the duration of the overflow are unknown. The overflow was stopped at 12:00PM. A sample was collected.

Sometime last week a manhole overflowed near Example Park.
